title: Parking Capacity and Fee Configuration
overview: One versioned configuration is shared by the entry, pricing, payment, lost-ticket, and occupancy components.
preconditions: The user is authenticated as a parking manager.
main_flow: The manager enters capacity, grace period, hourly rate, daily cap, lost-ticket fee, and currency.
The system creates a new version and makes it active.

alternative_flows.condition: A value is outside its valid range.
alternative_flows.result: Reject the update and identify the invalid fields.

business_rules: Money uses INR with two decimal places.
New versions do not rewrite prior versions.
